description:
Deploy a single token on a single chain. Validates parameters and returns an order action spec for inclusion in create_order.

Params: name (string), symbol (string), chain (string), supply (number), decimals (number), mintable (boolean), burnable (boolean), session_token (string)
Returns: {order_action_spec: {type, params}}
Errors: NO_SESSION, SESSION_EXPIRED, VALIDATION_ERROR, RATE_LIMITED

mintable.description: Whether additional tokens can be minted

name: deploy_token
title: Build a token creation action
